reason: A Web GUI plugin that lets users open registered DeepSeek Harness workspaces in detected or configured local editors, terminals, or file managers through an explicit workspace-menu action.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 界面中通过工作区菜单，将已注册的 DeepSeek Harness 工作区打开到检测到或配置的本地编辑器、终端或文件管理器中。
summaries.en: Open registered DeepSeek Harness workspaces from the Web interface in detected or configured local editors, terminals, or file managers.

capabilities: Detects available local editor, terminal, and file-manager launch targets
Launches an approved local application for a registered workspace after an explicit user action
Stores the preferred editor in browser-local state
